---
title: Connect Notion
description: Connect WriteStack to Notion AI as a custom MCP connection so Notion AI can read and schedule your Notes.
---

Notion AI connects to WriteStack with OAuth through a custom MCP connection.

## Steps

1. In Notion AI, open the connections settings and add a custom MCP server.
2. Paste the endpoint:
   ```text
   https://www.writestack.io/api/mcp/mcp
   ```
3. Notion opens WriteStack. Sign in and approve access.
4. Ask Notion AI, for example: "Turn this page into five Substack Notes and save them as drafts in WriteStack."

For screenshots of each step, follow the [Notion setup guide](https://blogs.writestack.io/?post=2-guides-add-mcp-connector-notion).

{/* TODO(orel): confirm the exact Notion menu path (it changes between Notion releases). */}

Scheduled Notes still need a Sync from WriteStack before they reach Substack. See [Sync](/docs/using/concepts/sync).
